title: fix(ui): land on home when an impersonation starts, and keep MCP agent sets out of the person permission-set picker
body:

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuVbp5Gt3wFjzgF6n64t9ySi)_

Refs #30212 — rows 1 and 4 only. Rows 2 and 3 stay on the card (see Acceptance notes).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：在系统设置里开始模拟用户后，直接进入被模拟用户的首页，不再停在「你没有访问此应用的权限」；给人员授权时的权限集下拉不再列出三个「MCP AI 助手」权限集。
- 为什么改：真实用户走查（#30212 第 1、4 行）发现模拟后落到无权限页，且给人授权时能选到只属于 AI 助手的权限集。
- 风险与回滚：只改控制台前端两处，无接口、无元数据变化；回滚即还原本 PR。已存的「人员持有 MCP 集」授权仍照常显示。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/ImpersonationBanner.tsx` 的 `useLandOnImpersonationStart`；`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/RegistryRefField.tsx` 的 `nonGrantableNames`。
- 两分钟验证：以管理员打开 系统设置 → 用户 → 任一非管理员用户 → 点「模拟用户」并确认，应落到该用户的首页且顶部有模拟横幅；在该用户的「权限集」页签点「新建」，下拉中不应出现「MCP AI 助手」。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Row 1, impersonation landing.** `ImpersonationBanner` gains `useLandOnImpersonationStart`: when a session the console already held as an ordinary one becomes impersonated, it navigates to `/`, where `RootLandingRedirect` resolves the landing for the identity now held. A boot into an impersonated session (reload, new tab, deep link) stays on its URL, and stopping an impersonation does not move the page. The navigate is the host's (`useHostNavigation`, supplied by `ConsoleShell`'s `HostNavigationBridge`), so the deployment basename applies and a tree with no host navigate does not move.
- **Row 4, agent sets in the person picker.** The `permission-ref` widget (the `permission_set` field of the `sys_user_permission_set` grant form opened from a person's Permission Sets tab) leaves the spec's `MCP_AGENT_PERMISSION_SETS` out of its options, through the same `nonGrantableNames` mechanism `position-ref` uses for the audience anchors. A stored agent set still shows as the row's own option, unflagged. `position-ref` is unchanged. The constant is imported statically from `@objectstack/spec/ai` (no root export); the console's OAuth consent page already imports that module's scope constants statically.
- One root changeset, `@object-ui/app-shell` + `@object-ui/fields` patch. No new language-pack key.

## Tests

- `ImpersonationBanner.test.tsx` — new top-level describe mounted under `MemoryRouter` + `HostNavigationBridge`: an ordinary session becoming impersonated navigates to `/`; a boot already impersonated stays on its URL; ending the impersonation does not move the page.
- `RegistryRefField.audienceAnchors-12200.test.tsx` — new describe: `permission-ref` offers no agent set; a stored agent set still shows by its label beside its name and writes nothing; `position-ref` does not apply the agent list. The old "permission-ref filters nothing" describe is renamed to what it still pins (it does not apply the anchor list).

<details><summary>Positive control: the new pins are red on main</summary>

Source files restored to the base (`git restore --source=c5800818`), tests kept, markers counted 0, then restored with `git checkout HEAD --` and `git diff HEAD` empty:

```
× offers the sets a person can hold and no agent set
× a stored agent set still shows by its label beside its name, unflagged, and writes nothing
× navigates to / when an ordinary session becomes impersonated
Tests  3 failed | 21 passed (24)
```
The boot-impersonated and stop cases pass on both sides by design (they pin what must not move).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Rows not shipped.** Row 2 (bulk-import set-password link lives 60 minutes) is a server credential-lifetime change owned by the server lane, and the card asks the dev to confirm the lifetime with the security seat. Row 3 (mail sender name defaults to `ObjectStack`) lives in `packages/plugins/plugin-email`, server lane. Both were outside this claim (`packages/**` fenced) and stay on #30212.
- Row 4 needed no server filter: the agent sets are named by the spec constant `MCP_AGENT_PERMISSION_SETS`. The picker lives in `ui/packages/fields`, not `views/metadata-admin`; the claim was amended to that surface before this PR.
- `pnpm check:eager-closure` was not run locally (needs a full console build); CI's bundle job weighs the static `@objectstack/spec/ai` import.

## Verification

Live, on a fresh `objectstack dev --seed-admin` showcase stack with the console on Vite, zh-CN, 1440 wide, admin impersonating a fresh member. Before = base source served, after = this branch. Screenshots sit on the never-merged branch `claude/project-thread-cro7hi-evidence`.

| | Before (main) | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Row 1, after confirming 「模拟用户」 on the member's Setup record | [lands on 你没有访问此应用的权限](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/65737b6c99c82685b06aa84c9102573b43923723/evidence/30212/before-row1-2-landed-zh-1440.png?raw=true) | [lands on the member's home (showcase landing page), banner up](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/65737b6c99c82685b06aa84c9102573b43923723/evidence/30212/after-row1-2-landed-zh-1440.png?raw=true) |
| Row 4, 权限集 tab → 新建 → 权限集 picker | [lists the three MCP AI 助手 sets](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/65737b6c99c82685b06aa84c9102573b43923723/evidence/30212/before-row4-permission-picker-zh-1440.png?raw=true) | [15 sets, no MCP AI 助手](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/65737b6c99c82685b06aa84c9102573b43923723/evidence/30212/after-row4-permission-picker-zh-1440.png?raw=true) |

Confirm dialog (same on both sides): [before-row1-1-confirm](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/65737b6c99c82685b06aa84c9102573b43923723/evidence/30212/before-row1-1-confirm-zh-1440.png?raw=true). Ending the impersonation kept the URL on both sides.
